description: Oluganda lwogerwa abantu bukade na bukade mu Buganda, wakati mu Uganda, mu Kampala n’okwetooloola.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Lusoga courses (#129) with low confidence in Lusoga; needs a native-speaker review.

why.title: Olulimi lw’**enguudo dh’e Kampala.**
why.text: Oluganda lwogerwa abantu bukade na bukade mu Uganda wakati, era lwe lulimi olusinga okwogerwa mu Kampala. Luyige oyogere n’ab’omu maka, ofune emikwano mu katale, era owulire ng’oli waka ku lugendo lwo.

cards.title: Eri ab’omu maka
cards.text: Yogera ne badhaadha era oyigirize abaana olulimi.

cards.title: Eri abatambuze
cards.text: Lamusa, kendeeza ku beeyi era otambule nga totya.

landing.audience: Aboogera Olusoga abatandika okuva ku ntandikwa, n’ab’omu maka abaagala okwogera ne baganda baabwe e Buganda.
landing.first: Okulamusa, okweyanjula n’enamba, oluvanyuma ab’omu maka, emere, akatale, esaawa, ebifo, awaka n’obulamu, ekitundu ku kitundu.
